hook.name: CURB FeeHook
hook.description: Fee hook for the CURB launchpad on Base. Restricts pool initialization to the designated poolOpener (Graduator). On each swap, charges a launch-specific trading tax split between a platform recipient and a creator: deducted from the input on buys via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, from the output on sells via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Exact-output swaps and partial fills revert.
